high_level_description: The image depicts a square ceramic tile with an intricate and colorful design. The background of the tile is a deep blue, which serves as a striking contrast to the vibrant colors of the floral patterns. The central motif features a symmetrical arrangement of flowers and leaves, predominantly in shades of yellow and green. The flowers have multiple petals and are detailed with small dots and lines, giving them a textured appearance. Surrounding the central design, there are smaller floral motifs and additional green leaves, creating a balanced and harmonious composition.
